messages:
alisa: Quick sync — onboarding Silverthorn-7B into the model catalog. Putting a short checklist here and tagging owners. Can folks confirm blockers and ETA for catalog launch gating? https://internal.models/silverthorn-7b

maria: I ran basic perf/accuracy sweeps on fp16 and int8. FP16 looks fine; int8 needs a tiny bias correction on LM loss at long seqs. Perf rough numbers: fp16 (seq512) = 22ms/ token p50, int8 (seq512) = 17ms/token after calibration. Will post artifacts in the perf bucket shortly.

devon: Re: runtime support — fused-attention kernel available on our 2.1 runtime, but we need a small graph rewrite for the rotary embeddings used here. I'll land a patch but need a test vector from model owners. Estimated 2 workdays + CI runs.

samir: Capacity note: Silverthorn's kv-cache ~1.25GB for 2048 tokens per shard. If we want Dedicated-ready throughput (batch=8), we'll need to reserve an extra slot or enable cache-sharding. Ping me with target qps.

alisa: Ownership table (please ack): model-catalog: alisa, perf: maria, runtime infra: devon, capacity/dedicated: samir, legal/license: nina. Please respond with ETA for your item.

maria: ETA for perf artifacts + calibrated int8 checkpoint: EOD Wednesday (2394080000-ish). I'll include the eval prompts and failure cases.

devon: ETA for runtime rewrite + CI: Thu noon PST. Will need a small change in loader to expose rotary block shape — PR coming.

samir: Need QPS target from the app/product team to size Dedicated pools. If no target, I'll size conservatively for 200 qps burst.

nina: Quick legal checklist: 1) upstream license text 2) proof-of-weights provenance 3) training-data high-level categories. We can't clear until #1 and #2 are in the legal intake PR. I can review within 48h after submission.

alisa: Linking intake form (please attach docs there): https://internal.intake/new?model=silverthorn-7b

ingest-bot: model intake submitted by alisa — status: pending_legal, pending_perf, pending_runtime. Intake ID: MI-239400-9

maria: small runnable snippet for runtime test (devon / infra QA):
```
./runtest --model silverthorn-7b --seq 512 --batch 1 --mode perf --out /tmp/silverthorn-run-512.json
```

devon: nice — that'll help. Also please include a seed list (5 samples) for deterministic CI.

maria: adding seed list to the perf artifacts.

nina: Alisa — can you add the upstream license file to the intake PR and a short note on data provenance? I'll triage then.

alisa: Yep doing that now. I want to lock gating for catalog launch by Friday COB — if any critical blockers, call them out now.

samir: If legal needs more time, Dedicated gating might slip. If perf/artifacts land on time I'll queue capacity.

maria: :thumbsup: will push artifacts before EOD Wed.

devon: I'll open the runtime PR in ~1h and mark as WIP. Will add test vectors once CI accepts them.

nina: I'll watch the intake PR and aim to review within 48h of submission.

alisa: Thanks all — filing follow-ups as TODOs in the intake ticket. If nothing else, I'll send a final launch-go/no-go check-in Fri morning.

samir: ack

maria: ack

devon: ack

nina: ack
